name: Tristate
h1: Keep brands, sourcing and reporting in step
lede: With its brand portfolio reset and a finance leadership transition under way, Airtable gives Tristate one connected place to run sourcing, merchandising and reporting work.
why_h2: Portfolio and leadership changes in the same year
why_p: Recent changes at Tristate touch brands, finance and half-year reporting at once, which is when connected operations data matters most.

signals.title: Interim results board meeting
signals.body: The board met on 25 August 2026 to approve interim results for the six months to 30 June 2026 and consider a dividend.
signals.angle: Half-year reporting across segments is easier when operations data is already connected.

signals.title: Finance and company secretary changes
signals.body: The CFO and company secretary resigned effective 29 July 2026 and a new company secretary was appointed.
signals.angle: A connected layer makes processes and handovers visible to new finance and governance leaders.

signals.title: Reebok Greater China licence ended early
signals.body: Tristate's Reebok licensing agreement in Greater China was terminated early, effective 31 December 2025.
signals.angle: Keep sourcing, merchandising and retail plans aligned as the brand portfolio changes.
signals.src: Simply Wall St company announcements, Dec 2025
